notes.title: Endless Road: Reborn BIG UPDATE & CHANGES!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632002/908dabb0bffb3c502b205d46c4b7393b6dd188b1.jpg[/img][h1][b]3.0 Update[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632002/02a78b43f1b9b32bb7a4f02b8172bad42f4c89d7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Visual Remake[/h2]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632002/723b41ea87477a5cf64bb41799d322e4cf3d393b.png[/img]

[*] The start page has been reworked, with newly-created 3D character models added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632002/ab6435e349f05d660af2fd14c5d6c704b292670e.png[/img]

[*] Reworked character selection page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632002/429b5864efe490dedf92f8e222779b9e11a783b7.jpg[/img]

[*] Reworked map interface. The layout of interactive elements has been optimized, making it neater and more beautiful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632002/36e0fd4b28751d3f78d73cffb1d8e247d92e9571.jpg[/img]
[*] Reworked the battle scene, removing the "earthy" tones and adding more color and ambient elements.
[*] Refined Howitzer, Necrolyte, and character images.
[*] Reworked the q-version images of all characters.
[*] Enhanced Talents for all characters.
[*] There will be an obvious visual cue in the form of special effects for critical strikes.
[/list]

[h2]Sound Remake[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the main menu background music.
[*] Reworked the overworld background music.
[*] Added background music to page after beating the boss.
[*] Added two new battle music tracks.
[*] Added a series of skill and interaction sound effects.
[/list]

[h2]Map Remake[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed Stamina mechanic. (Developer's Note: The Stamina mechanic has long been a huge problem for new players, but practically a non-existent factor for skilled players. It was simply a redundant feature for the player. Therefore, after careful evaluation, we believe that removing Stamina will provide players with a better gaming experience.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32632002/8a5ed188657be2302ceb39cbe34ec6828fe1dd72.png[/img]
[*] Reworked the road generation algorithm and forward logic. Now two roads will be lit at the same time after rolling the dice. Additionally, the character walking animation has been removed, which shortens interaction speeds on the map.
[*] When speaking to enemies, the speech bubble pops up at the bottom left, and will no longer be blocked by the UI on the screen.
[*] Removed the roulette and enhancement events, and added a card selection event.
[*] Added the ability to use hold and slide gestures to open menus, use items, etc.
[*] EXP is now automatically obtained after defeating an enemy. No longer necessary to manually click and use data packets every time to gain EXP.
[*] When stepping on a treasure chest, it will automatically skip it if the player doesn't have enough gold coins.
[/list]

[h2]Combat Remake[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed "chance to trigger effect" aspects of all skills, cards and passives. This has now been replaced by the new "Assault" mechanic (see the new content for details), which greatly improves the strategy of the game and reduces the "luck" component.
[*] Reworked starting card decks. Originally, characters would start with empty cards that could then have skills equipped to them via accessories acquired later. Now, each character has an initial card library, containing cards with skills, and all acquired accessories will instead add new cards to the library. (Developer's Note: The original design made it impossible to effectively expand the deck during the game, and the experience of each battle was too similar for across each character. Therefore, we have reworked the entire deck building mechanic, hoping to make each battle more unique between different playthroughs.)
[*] Simplified overall game stat calculations. Removed all percent multiplication and division, as well as adjustments for doubling and halving effects. (Developer's Note: The original stat system was too complicated, overwhelming, and contained too many percentage calculations. Hopefully, calculating stats, damage, and other stats will be much easier now for players.)
[*] The max number of hand cards has been increased to 10 cards, and only 4 cards are drawn in the beginning. (Developer's Note: Giving players the ability to hold more hand cards should make battling more flexible.)
[*] Rage must be greater than or equal to 100% to trigger Critical strikes.
[*] Removed the level mechanic of Talents and using Blessings to upgrade Talents, and reworked all Talents skills to make them easier to understand. (Developer's Note: It turned out that by allowing players to upgrade Talents, it ended up overcomplicating Talents and gameplay. These mechanics weren't much fun and caused problems for new players.)
[*] Skill effect values ​​of accessories and gems are no longer affected by quality. (Developer Note: We want players to focus on the combination of effects, not the stacking of stats.)
[/list]

[h2]New content[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "Assault" skill type has been ​​upgraded to "Assault (x)": Triggers when X of this card is/are played in one turn.
[*] New skill type, "Explore": Choose one of three displayed cards and add them to your hand.
[*] New character "Inventor".
[/list]
Talent 1 - Practical Problems: Use X-number of hand cards with the highest point value. Select Y-number of Invention card(s) then start the duel.
Talent 2 - Greater Good: Discard X-number of hand cards with the highest point value. Select Y to Z-number of Invention card(s)."
   Additionally, a series of accessories and gems related to "Invention Cards" have been added.
 New blessings
       When entering a battle, if there are at least 30 cards in the deck, select one card in your deck and add it to your hand.
       Health regeneration effects increased by 2.
       When entering a battle, increase the attack power by 1 for every 3 non-initial cards.
       When entering a battle, for each non-initial card, increase max HP by 1.

That's all of the updated content for 3.0. We hope you can have a better game experience in the new version! Thank you for playing our game!

[h3][b]*How to enter the test version[/b][/h3]
[h2] Entering the test server will delete your current save and game!! Please backup in advance!! Archive location "C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\ZZ\EndlessRoad"[/h2]

notes.title: 2.0版本近期修改汇总
notes.content:
1.剧毒陷阱现在在2回合后（触发3次效果）会自我丢弃。
2.死灵第二天赋现在不需要使用，就能触发反击效果。并且一次会召唤3个炸弹。
3.死灵第一天赋现在只需要丢弃两张牌就能召唤一个骷髅。

6.提高了前进时概率丢弃物品和装备的加成。
7.免疫效果可以一直观察到了。

9.修复积累页面消耗金币没有算到总消耗的金币里的bug。
10.机关王现在将会根据死亡时自身的攻击力进行分裂。
11.大量不可描述的数值调整。
12.修复机关王分裂会导致游戏卡住的bug。 
13.活体炸弹改回基于地方攻击力计算伤害。
14.成就积分修改
子孙满堂：在一场首领战斗中在己方场上累计召唤了{0}个仆从。
开枝散叶：在一场首领战斗中在敌方场上累计召唤了{0}个仆从。

源源不断: 在一场首领战斗中有一回合额外抽取了{0}张牌。

16.修复“奥义：摧毁所有仆从并重新召唤他们。”不会触发召唤抽牌的bug。
17.“丢弃获得免疫”的手牌技能变为“丢弃增加护甲”。
18.在地图中添加可以查看当前已获得的成就积分的详细页面。
19.在进度条的位置可以查看当前层是什么首领。

21.物品宝箱只有草的诅咒变为路上的物品宝箱只有草。
22.修复免疫特效会和模型穿插的问题。
23.全面降低诅咒的倍率影响。
24.修复大量和实时积分内容相关的bug。

notes.title: 测试服2.0版本第一部分内容更新
notes.content: [b]1.去除无尽模式。[/b] 长久以来无尽模式的体验不尽如人意，并且显得很鸡肋。故而将在2.0版本去除无尽模式，同时将来会使地狱模式可以不断开启更高的难度。原有的进度和信仰之力将会折算成新的幸运石和积分。 [b]2.添加积分幸运石系统。[/b] 每一局战斗结束时会根据你的角色数据，击杀数，总共在战斗中消耗的回合数计算积分。积分又会折算成幸运石，而幸运石可以用于购买特殊能力。 目前有以下几种： ·开局时获得一个灌草 ·开局时获得一个大血瓶 ·开局时获得一个地图残片 ·开局时获得15金币 ·你的体力上限变为40点。 ·你在商店里购买的第一个物品不消耗金币 ·开局时即可选择一个祝福。 ·每次前进可以恢复1点体力。 ·物价下降10%。 ·结算获得幸运石时需要的积分减少。（从200/每个下降为150/每个） ·你遇到的第一只精英怪只有1点生命。 ·开局时你的天赋技能即为2级。 [b]3.添加突击机制[/b] 长久以来为了避免出现bug，无尽之路卡牌技能的结算都是在战斗之后进行结算的，但是我们发现这种延迟反馈的机制不易产生爽快感，故而我们对大量技能进行了调整，改为了突击触发（使用后即触发）。 目前有以下几种： ~对敌人造成 {0} 点伤害。 ~恢复自己 {0} 点生命。 ~本回合增加 {0} 点攻击力。 ~增加自己 {0} 点护甲。 ~对敌人造成等于你护甲数值的伤害。 ~消除 {0} 张敌方 {1} 手牌上的技能。 ~{0}% 概率复制 {1} 张 {2} 手牌。 ~场上每张牌恢复自身 {0} 点生命。 ~随机摧毁 {0} 张敌方手牌。 ~该牌点数变成最大值。 ~随机摧毁 {0} 个敌方场上的卡牌。 ~每{0}点攻击力增加{1}点护甲。 ~减少{0}点生命，增加{1}点护甲。 ~本回合免疫伤害。 ~摧毁己方场上最小点数卡牌，攻击力增加{0}点。 ~抽 {0} 张牌。 ~往敌方牌库里添加{0}张：{1} ~使敌人抽取{0}张陷阱牌 ~使敌方牌库里{0}张非陷阱卡牌变成：{1} ~使敌方{0}张手牌变成：{1} ~{0}% 概率，添加{1}张{2}卡牌到牌库。 ~双方各抽{0}张牌。 ~使敌方丢弃{0}张牌库里的牌。 ~受到等同自身攻击力的伤害，摧毁敌方{0}张手牌。 ~使最左侧的{0}张手牌回到牌库，抽{1}张牌。 ~装填{0}个烈焰弹。 ~{0}% 概率，复制{1}张该牌到手中。 ~召唤一个:{0} ~摧毁你的所有仆从，每个仆从使你的总点数增加{0}点。 ~场上的每个仆从使你恢复{0}%生命。 [b]4.添加了新的诅咒[/b] ~无法看到道路上的内容。 ~没有精英怪。 ~在100回合内完成游戏。 ~箱子里只有灌草。 ~不能选择道路。 ~体力为0就死亡。 ~装备的属性都为0。 ~命运之石出现的概率降低。 [b]5.技能概率触发去除[/b] 一直以来无尽之路的随机性被严重诟病，为了进一步降低随机性。 我们去除了90%卡牌技能的概率触发特性，并且把许多随机指定的效果改为了指向性指定（如，抽取最大点数牌；摧毁最右侧的牌等。） 因修改的技能太多了，就不一一列举了。（其实是因为制作人太懒不愿整理。） [b]6.新的解锁机制[/b] 为了进一步降低新手的上手程度，放缓学习曲线，我们在初期锁定部分强力敌人，随着玩家不断积累积分后，将会逐步解锁这些怪物。 [b]7.其他修改[/b] 受到伤害和恢复生命时的数字动画，在连续触发时，更易观察清楚了。 提高了角色的初始卡牌的最小点数。 [b]8.即将到来的新内容。[/b] 新角色：占星师 新机制：升级选单卡系统。神祗系统（任务技能）。 新事件：装备强化事件。幸运大转盘事件。 新模式：每日模式。（替代无尽模式，并加入全球排行榜。） [h1]最后说一句，我们去移植手游并不是为了圈钱，是为了赶上申请版号好能在国区正式上线，况且手游的收入目前为止才几万块···比steam少太多了···[/h1]

notes.title: 0.9.9 Version Update!!! More new content!
notes.content:
Thank you for your support to us after the game is released.
In just two months, we fixed a lot of bugs in the game, stabilized the version of the game, graded the difficulty, constantly optimized the UI and player experience, and completed our commitment, developed and improved. Endless mode.
Today, we will [b] update version 0.99[/b] to add more new content.
[b]New game mechanics[/b]
[olist]
[*]Trap Card: You can add a trap card to the enemy library, which will have various effects when the enemy draws.
[*] Shuffling mechanism: The hand can be washed back to its own library and re-extracted by skills and props.
[*]Task system: There are a lot of tasks on the map that can be completed and rewarded.
[*]Cursing System: Hell mode and endless mode can choose to add curse at the beginning, which changes the difficulty of lifting.
[*]The new character: Mystery Traveler, a character that adds traps and restores life as the core gameplay. Like the other three characters, she also has two new talents that are unique to her. Old players who have purchased the game can unlock and use this character for free.
[*]New equipment: 34 new gears, giving you more choices
[/olist]
[b]New multilingual text[/b]
English and Japanese have been re-examined to improve the readability of the text.
[b]More refined UI design[/b]
[olist]
[*] Reproduce and replace a lot of UI content.
[*]Modified icons for some skills and props.
[/olist]

[b] Due to the large amount of updates, some old players may have archive damage. The path to the archive is in C:\User\username\AppData\LocalLow\ZZ\EndlessRoad. It is recommended that you back up your archives before starting the game. If you can't load by clicking Continue, please exit the game and click on the new game to play. [/b]

August is nearing the end, and we haven't written an update log for almost a whole month (mainly because the producers are too lazy), and we are still trying to update every day!

I am really grateful to the players for their companionship. Our game is very rough from the very beginning, and it is getting better and better under the constant feedback.

The official version of the game will be officially released in September, and the price will increase. We promise to open the cloud archive and open the steam card when the official version starts to sell. There are more optimizations and adjustments at the same time.

Thank you all the way to help us. We will continue to work hard!
